SELECT COUNT(*) FROM account_transaction WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT user_id, balance, created_at, updated_at FROM user_account WHERE user_id = #{userId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT user_id, chapter_id, novel_id, unit_price, paid_amount, txn_no, request_no, status, subscribed_at, refunded_at FROM chapter_subscription WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND chapter_id = #{chapterId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE chapter_subscription SET status = 'REFUNDED', refunded_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND chapter_id = #{chapterId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chapter_subscription WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reward_tip t WHERE (#{direction} = 'OUT' AND t.from_user_id = #{userId}) OR (#{direction} = 'IN' AND t.to_user_id = #{userId})

SELECT , #{direction} AS direction FROM reward_tip t JOIN novel n ON n.novel_id = t.novel_id LEFT JOIN chapter c ON c.chapter_id = t.chapter_id JOIN app_user cp ON cp.user_id = IF(#{direction} = 'OUT', t.to_user_id, t.from_user_id) WHERE (#{direction} = 'OUT' AND t.from_user_id = #{userId}) OR (#{direction} = 'IN' AND t.to_user_id = #{userId}) ORDER BY t.created_at DESC, t.tip_id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
